rule: Reusable family components = shared DESIGN. Each node binds them to its own data, interactions and states.

components.name: Top navigation
components.purpose: Tight navigation with the simple AIO mark only; search, notifications, identity (public: section anchors + GET STARTED).

responsive.MOBILE: mark · search · bell · avatar (public: mark · search · GET STARTED · menu)

rules: LOCKED: SIMPLE_MARK_ONLY — never the full lockup
never the legacy AIONav geometry

components.name: Quarter hero
components.purpose: Cinematic perimeter + high-visibility quarter identity (IFTA FILING ROOM · Q{n} {YYYY} · period · line) + state chip. Staff: client identity + account. Public: SAMPLE quarter + SEE HOW IT WORKS.

responsive.DESKTOP: wide, shorter; staff health panel top-right

rules: tab-specific title line on child tabs (e.g. Q3 2026 FUEL PURCHASES)
media is a perimeter, never behind data

components.name: Metrics rail
components.purpose: Four live quarter metrics (miles · fuel gal · jurisdictions · tax due / credit); tab-specific sets on child tabs; staff adds prior-quarter deltas; public shows SAMPLE values.
rules: TAX slot reads the staff return summary only (decision D-TAX-FIGURES)

components.name: Tab bar
components.purpose: First-class tab family of the quarter (client: PROGRESS · FUEL PURCHASES · MILEAGE · VEHICLES · JURISDICTIONS · DOCUMENTS; staff: OVERVIEW first + EXPORT REPORT).
rules: active · inactive · hover · disabled pill states (asset sheet)

components.name: Quarter selector
components.purpose: Switch to another quarter (history / next quarter).

responsive.DESKTOP: right end of the tab bar

components.name: Next-action rail
components.purpose: Exactly one dark rail with the single next thing for this tab × state (client: GO TO / CONTINUE / APPROVE; staff: OPEN RETURN DRAFT …).

responsive.DESKTOP: bottom-left beside the band (client) · full width (staff)

components.name: Help rail
components.purpose: NEED HELP? MESSAGE YOUR AIO TEAM.

components.name: Lower brand band
components.purpose: Full AIO lockup + band line (client DATA · COMPLIANCE · REAL PROGRESS; staff OPERATIONS · COMPLIANCE · CLIENT SUCCESS; public DRIVEN BY COMPLIANCE. BUILT FOR WHAT MOVES YOU.).

responsive.DESKTOP: lockup beside the rail / band line right

rules: LOCKED: the only place the full lockup appears

components.name: Filing workflow
components.purpose: Four phases DATA COLLECTION → AIO PREPARATION → CLIENT REVIEW → FILE & CONFIRM (staff adds dates).
rules: phase mapping D-PROGRESS-PHASES

components.name: Task list / checklist
components.purpose: Client: six checklist lines (fuel purchases · mileage · vehicles · return preparation · your review & approval · filing & confirmation). Staff: quarter tasks with assignee + due.
rules: client never sees staff-internal tasks (decision D-CLIENT-DESKTOP-STAFF-MODULES)

components.name: Map panel
components.purpose: Jurisdiction breakdown map + legend (share of miles); public: lit network map (sample).

components.name: Mileage-by-jurisdiction bars
components.purpose: Miles per jurisdiction (bars + values).

components.name: Fuel donut
components.purpose: Fuel gallons by jurisdiction (overview) or spend by vendor (fuel tab).

components.name: Jurisdiction table
components.purpose: Per jurisdiction: miles · gallons · allocation · net tax (summary only) · data quality · review status.
rules: derived from the legend list + table row family; no rates column (D-TAX-FIGURES)

components.name: Receipt status summary
components.purpose: Counts by receipt status (processed · needs review · missing details · duplicate · unreadable · possible missing).

components.name: Receipt row
components.purpose: Date · vendor (text) · STATE · gallons · amount · status chip · row menu.
rules: vendor names as text (D-VENDOR-LOGOS)
STATE column added (D-FUEL-STATE-COLUMN)

components.name: Upload zone
components.purpose: Drag & drop / choose files (PDF, JPG, PNG, max 10MB each); camera on mobile; import from Vault; import CSV.

components.name: Mileage source picker
components.purpose: ELD / GPS (not live) · ELD report upload · manual state entry · spreadsheet · AIO assistance.
rules: derived from the task-list row + upload zone parts

components.name: CSV / report mapper
components.purpose: Map columns and validate before import.
rules: contract sheet #02 “map fields and validate”; built from modal + table row family

components.name: Mileage row
components.purpose: Per truck: miles by state, source badge (VERIFIED / AWAITING VERIFICATION / ESTIMATE), exceptions.
rules: estimate is visually distinct (stone, ESTIMATE) and never looks filed-ready

components.name: Vehicle row
components.purpose: Unit · miles · gallons · participation · readiness dot.

components.name: File row
components.purpose: File badge · name · date · status; open / download / share.

components.name: Recent uploads
components.purpose: Latest source files for the quarter.

components.name: Activity timeline
components.purpose: Client: recent IFTA activity (customer-visible kinds only). Staff: RECENT CLIENT ACTIVITY + AIO TEAM ACTIVITY.

responsive.DESKTOP: table (event · date / type · activity · date · by)

rules: client reads IFTA kinds with visibility customer only (G-ACTIVITY-PRIVACY)

components.name: AIO insights
components.purpose: Plain-language line of what AIO is doing / found (aioDoingLine, nextStepLine).

components.name: Status chip
components.purpose: Complete green · in progress blue · pending gray · attention amber; quarter state chip in the hero.

components.name: Risks / flags
components.purpose: Open flags and discrepancies with the fix inline (client: NEEDS YOU; staff: RISKS / FLAGS).

components.name: Client health panel
components.purpose: Staff-only dark panel: data completeness · fuel receipts n/n · jurisdictions n/n · return readiness + risk chip.
rules: risk tier has no backing model (STAFF.read.health PARTIAL)

components.name: Important dates
components.purpose: Return period · draft target · client review · file & pay deadline.

components.name: Return summary sheet
components.purpose: Decision window: miles · gallons · MPG · tax due / credit by jurisdiction (client approve / ask; staff draft + worksheet).

responsive.MOBILE: metrics rail + stacked jurisdiction rows + rail

rules: derived: metrics rail + jurisdiction table + next-action rail (no new composition)

components.name: Detail drawer
components.purpose: Record detail / edit surface for receipts, mileage, vehicles, jurisdictions, files, audit, threads.
rules: contract sheet #03 “open detail drawer”; card + shadow level 3

components.name: Confirm / form modal
components.purpose: Decisions that change the quarter (send to AIO, approve, request correction, record filing / payment, reopen) and short forms.

components.name: Message thread
components.purpose: Quarter request thread (client ↔ AIO).

components.name: Empty state
components.purpose: Panel-level empty copy + the capture action (e.g. “NO FUEL PURCHASES YET. UPLOAD RECEIPTS OR IMPORT YOUR CSV FILE.”).

components.name: Fuel tax queue
components.purpose: Client-quarters by due date × readiness with hub buckets (AWAITING CLIENT · BLOCKED · NEEDS REVIEW · READY TO FILE · COMPLETE).
rules: no reference authority (gap G-STAFF-QUEUE / decision D-STAFF-QUEUE-AUTHORITY)

components.name: Clear-path explainer
components.purpose: A CLEAR PATH FROM MILES TO COMPLIANCE — what AIO handles + evidence image card + GET STARTED.
rules: copy from the experience contract (D-PUBLIC-COPY-TRUTH)

components.name: Process steps
components.purpose: Five steps: fuel purchases · mileage by jurisdiction · vehicle & trip data · return preparation · filing & confirmation.

responsive.DESKTOP: five tiles in a row with step numbers

components.name: Built-for pillars
components.purpose: BUILT FOR OWNER OPERATORS AND FLEETS — ACCURATE · EFFICIENT · COMPLIANT.

components.name: Resource tiles
components.purpose: RESOURCES section: what IFTA is, who needs it, due dates, what to send — as pillar-style tiles.
rules: derived from the pillar tile pattern; the nav item exists in the reference, the section composition does not

components.name: Request-filing form
components.purpose: Company, contact, fleet size, base jurisdiction, IFTA account yes / no → quote request.
rules: fields from the existing request engine; derived from modal + button family
